title: A integer overflow that can lead to a buffer overrread in the XRes QueryResourceBytes Swap Path in the X.Org xwayland…
description: An integer overflow vulnerability exists in the XRes QueryResourceBytes Swap Path in X.Org xwayland before version 24.1.15 and X Server before version 21.1.26 on 32-bit systems. This flaw can be exploited by authenticated clients to cause a buffer overread, potentially crashing the X server.
